scope: Owned standalone i686 fixture with cdecl conversion, Wine-GDB on Wine 10.0-20260425; no game or client.
observation: Both pass-through and replacement modes reported an exact Title2 match and a validated return of nine UTF-16 units. Replacement mode reported a nine-unit substitution; both inferiors exited normally and Wine-GDB returned zero without an internal fatal error. The fixture source returns zero only if count, two canaries and terminator match; its stdout was not captured in the debugger log, so replacement code units were not independently observed.
cleanup: Separate private namespaces with loopback only and no IPv4 or IPv6 default route; no remaining namespace processes. Fixture and hook hashes were unchanged.
limits: Two finite fixture runs, not a proof of game debugger stability, injected code units, glyph drawing, IME, packet handling or UTF-8 client compatibility.
